en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5674 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Imam (as) about a disowned son (makhlooh) whose father publicly renounces him before the authorities and disclaims both his inheritance and responsibility for his actions.
I asked: "Who inherits from him (the father)?"
Imam (as) replied: "Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) ruled: 'His inheritance goes to the closest relatives of his father.'"
